title: Venonat's Large Eyes Hide Tiny Radar Clusters

direction.premise: Venonat's large eyes are clusters of many tiny eyes that act as radar.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal what Venonat's large eyes contain, then show how those clusters work in darkness.
direction.openLoop: Why do Venonat's large eyes need clusters of tiny eyes?
direction.payoff: Its tiny-eye clusters become visible in bright light, then act as radar in darkness.
direction.engagementQuestion: Are Venonat's tiny-eye clusters brilliant radar, or nightmare fuel?

voice.instructions: Use a curious, tense pace. Start sharply, slow down during the eye zoom, then punch the final question.

scenes.headline: LARGE EYES. TINY RADAR.
scenes.narration: Venonat's large eyes hide tiny radar clusters.
scenes.caption: WHAT IS INSIDE THEM?

scenes.headline: THE CLUSTERS APPEAR
scenes.narration: Bright light reveals what those large eyes are made of.
scenes.caption: ZOOM IN

scenes.headline: THE CLUSTER ACTS AS RADAR
scenes.narration: Those tiny clusters act as radar when darkness hides prey.
scenes.caption: RADAR IN THE DARK

scenes.headline: DARKNESS CANNOT HIDE BUGS
scenes.narration: Radar lets Venonat catch small bugs that hide in darkness.
scenes.caption: SMALL BUGS CANNOT HIDE

scenes.headline: LIGHT CHANGES THE SCENE
scenes.narration: But at night, light attracts Venonat's kind toward it.
scenes.caption: LIGHT REVEALS AND ATTRACTS

scenes.headline: BRILLIANT OR NIGHTMARE FUEL?
scenes.narration: Tiny-eye clusters: radar in darkness. Brilliant or nightmare fuel?
scenes.caption: WHICH ONE?
